_help: Things you do TO another sibling. cond is checked on you, target_cond on the pair (t_age, t_money... are the target's stats; rel = your relationship; owes = how much you owe them). consent: true sends a popup the target can accept/decline (then 'accept'/'decline' apply). Otherwise 'outcomes' are rolled right away. self/target = effects. rel = relationship change. transfer moves {amount} of money. log = Family Log line.

actions.label: Hang out
actions.ask: {self} wants to hang out with you!

actions.label: Help with homework
actions.target_cond: t_age >= 6 and t_age <= 22 and t_age < age

accept.self_text: You helped {target} study. They're getting smarter! 🧠

decline.self_text: {target} said they're fine on their own. 🙄
decline.target_text: You told {self} you don't need help.

topic: whose turn it is to do the dishes 🍽️

outcomes.self_text: You WON the argument with {target} about {topic}. 😤
outcomes.target_text: 😤 {self} argued with you about {topic}... and won.

outcomes.self_text: You lost the argument with {target} about {topic}. 😩
outcomes.target_text: 😤 {self} picked a fight with you about {topic}. You won! 😎

prank: put a fake spider in their shoe 🕷️
glued googly eyes on everything they own 👀
put plastic wrap on the toilet 🚽
changed their phone language to Klingon 🖖
hid a whoopee cushion under their chair 💨

outcomes.self_text: Your prank backfired spectacularly. {target} saw it coming. 🤦
outcomes.target_text: {self} tried to prank you and failed. LOL. 😎

accept.self_text: {target} lent you {amount}. Don't forget to pay it back! 💸

decline.self_text: {target} said no to lending you money. 😒

outcomes.self_text: You paid {amount} to bail {target} out of jail! 🔓
outcomes.target_text: 🔓 {self} paid {amount} to bail you out of jail! You're free!

outcomes.self_text: You told the police about {target}'s crimes. They got 1 year in jail. 🐀
outcomes.target_text: 🐀 {self} snitched on you! You got 1 year in jail.
outcomes.log: 🐀 {self} snitched on {target} — and {target} went to jail!

outcomes.self_text: You told on {target}. The police are watching them now. 🐀
outcomes.target_text: 🐀 {self} told on you! The cops (and your parents) are watching you now.
